_comment: Bindings for the macro-metrics corpus beside this file, read off
origin/main@89053e6 — nothing invented, same rule as every other corpus.
⚠️ THE NOUNS HERE ARE STILL HAND-PREFIXED (page:MacroHome, not page:Home) and
they no longer need to be. The prefix existed to dodge a global namespace that
this file is the end of: snip-it's page:Home was "./" and this app's is
"/macro-metrics/", one flat map away from each other. Now that a corpus binds
its own nouns, that collision cannot happen — so the prefixes are harmless
history rather than a rule. Renaming them is a corpus change and therefore
James's, not a tidy-up (claude-code-bot#58).
DELIBERATELY ABSENT, each an honest refusal rather than a gap:
link:Presets / link:Compare / link:Indicators — the AC says "anchor links";
StickyNav.tsx renders <button onClick={scrollIntoView}>. Binding these to
the buttons would let the corpus absorb the divergence, which is the
Gherkin failure.
ratio:Errored, ratio:OneErrored — macro-metrics has ZERO .spec.ts files, so
no route-mock helper exists to bind a `given` to. Refuse, do not invent.
button:Range1y … button:RangeMax — these have PERFECT accessible names ("1y"
… "Max"). They are absent because NINE PresetCards each render all six, so
the noun names 9 elements and any locator is ambiguous under Playwright
strict mode. The notation has no cardinality; this is where that stops
being a nit.
card:<any one preset card> — PresetCard's root is role="button" with NO
accessible name (its text is dynamic title/value), so a single card cannot
be addressed.
